name: Hologram
description: In a dark control room scanlines sweep the body and turn the subject into a flickering projection.

wardrobe.man: a dark grey technical jacket and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a dark grey technical jacket and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a dark grey technical jacket and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands in the middle of a dark futuristic control room, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. Banks of glowing screens with abstract blue light patterns line the walls on both sides, thin cyan light strips run along the floor, and a light haze hangs in the air. Medium shot at eye level from four metres away, the {subject} centered from the knees up. Cinematic sci-fi photography, cool cyan screen light from both sides, deep shadows, a soft blue rim on the shoulders. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, screens showing only abstract light patterns throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the control room, eyes on a point just past the camera. A bright horizontal band of blue light sweeps down the body from head to toe, and everything it passes turns into a translucent blue hologram made of light, with fine horizontal scanlines, a soft glow and the room visible through it; the hologram flickers, glitches sideways for a few frames and stabilizes again, tiny particles of light drifting off its edges, until by the last second the {subject} is a steady flickering projection standing above a faint ring of light on the floor. The camera pushes in slowly. Sound: a rising electronic sweep, a soft crackle of static on each glitch, the hum of the machines. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, holographic light with scanlines and flicker, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame stays in place. A bright horizontal band of blue light sweeps down the body, and everything it passes turns into a translucent blue hologram made of light, with fine scanlines and a soft glow; the hologram flickers and glitches sideways for a few frames and stabilizes again, particles of light drifting off its edges. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a rising electronic sweep, soft static crackles. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, holographic light with scanlines and flicker, sharp detail, stable picture.
